decision: Stop before runtime mutation and reserved execution. Released 0.4.2 and a capable no-skill assistant both reconciled the supplied conflicts, preserved older evidence, answered screening questions truthfully, respected limits and omitted private explanations in all four development families.
interpretation: These cases do not show that source reconciliation is solved generally. They show that explicit candidate corrections and well-bounded fictional records still give a capable general assistant enough information to match the released skill. Adding another reconciliation checklist without an observed defect would not meet the project's improvement standard.
next_dependency: A further runtime attempt needs ecologically stronger, permissioned or carefully anonymised multi-version material, or a synthetic reproduction of a real recurring correction burden whose answer is not already stated cleanly in candidate notes.
